testCases.title: ❌ Flawed Enterprise Launch Ad (Contains Claims & Tone Drift)
testCases.content: 🚀 We are crazy excited to announce CloudScale 3.0! It's the cheapest and most bulletproof AI cloud on the planet. We are the #1 Rated AI Cloud in the World and guarantee 99.999% uptime with zero exceptions. Plus, every customer gets unlimited GPU inference with zero throttling. Sign up today and start crushing your AI development!
expectedFlags: SLA Claim: 'guarantee 99.999% uptime with zero exceptions' violates official 99.95% SLA (SLA Section 4.2).
Superlative: '#1 Rated AI Cloud in the World' is unverified and contradicts approved investor claim.
Prohibited Term: 'cheapest' violates premium enterprise brand positioning.
Prohibited Term: 'unlimited' violates FTC truth-in-advertising guidelines.
Tone Drift: 'crazy excited' and 'crushing your AI' violate authoritative professional voice.

testCases.title: ✅ Fully Compliant Enterprise Announcement
testCases.content: CloudScale announces the general availability of its Next-Generation Enterprise AI Infrastructure. Recognized as a Strong Performer in the 2026 Cloud AI Infrastructure Evaluation, the platform delivers scalable high-capacity inference backed by a financially-supported 99.95% enterprise SLA. All customer workloads are secured via defense-in-depth architecture with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

testCases.title: ⚠️ Borderline Social Ad (Minor Tone & Disclaimer Deficit)
testCases.content: Scale your LLM models faster than ever with CloudScale. Our developer tier is only $49/month with instant provisioning and dedicated Slack support. Build without worry on our secure cloud.
expectedFlags: Factual Inaccuracy: 'dedicated Slack support' is only available on the Enterprise Growth tier ($499/mo), not the Developer tier ($49/mo).
